node.opening: There's been movement around the neighborhood today.
node.details: Mostly tracks, open doors, and noises carrying farther than they should.
node.personal: It has kept me alert. I haven't decided whether that's useful or exhausting.
node.followup: That's the shape of it. We can act on it or keep watching.
node.closing: If anything changes, it will probably happen quickly.
choice.offer_help: I can help check the area.
choice.press: Show me the signs you found.
choice.reassure: You don't have to watch it alone.
choice.challenge: Fear can make every shadow look dangerous.
response.detail.open: A few infected drifted east, then something drew them back toward the houses.
response.detail.guarded: Nothing I can prove yet. Just a pattern I don't like.
response.personal.open: Better now that someone else knows what I saw.
response.personal.guarded: I'm managing. Let's keep this about the situation.
response.offer_help.open: Good. A second set of eyes could keep this from becoming a surprise.
response.offer_help.guarded: Maybe. Don't commit until we know what we're walking into.
response.press.open: The broken weeds and scuffed dirt form a line behind the last three yards.
response.press.guarded: You're reading too much into scraps, but the route is behind the houses.
response.reassure.open: I appreciate that more than I expected.
response.reassure.guarded: I can handle a watch, but... thanks.
response.challenge.open: True. That's why I checked twice before mentioning it.
response.challenge.guarded: Call it fear if you want. I call it staying alive.
response.advice.open: Watch the east road at dusk and avoid making noise near the back lots.
response.advice.guarded: Wait, listen, and don't chase a problem we haven't identified.
response.wrap_up.open: Fair. You know what I know now.
response.promise.open: Then I know the warning wasn't wasted.
response.leave.open: Do that. It may matter before tomorrow.
locked.personal: You do not know each other well enough for that question.
locked.skill: You need more Foraging experience to interpret the trail.
locked.personality: This NPC is not receptive to being challenged this way.
locked.promise: They do not trust your promises yet.
